global_release_boundaries: No chapter may be called live, complete, release-ready, exported, or published from static wiring, fixtures, generated cards, MCP schemas, command acknowledgements, or this draft.

The eight gameplay chapters require lineage-bound clean spans from real managed CK3 sessions, with one canonical seed/save lineage and exact source/game/mod mount; each span binds its own continuous pre-action-post session, checkpoints, postcondition, and cleanup.
Opening and finale cards may be generated only during a future candidate build; they cannot substitute for any gameplay span.
Chinese narration and simultaneous Chinese/English subtitles remain draft text until final footage is reviewed; no TTS, subtitle render, or media output is authorized by this ledger.
Release use additionally requires the media-preflight receipt, capture evidence, final render validation, and human review gates already defined by the phase-two readiness ledger.
